guide.title: Seedance 2.5 prompt guide
guide.intro: Patterns that repeat across the examples below, each with a template you can fill in.

items.formula: Subject + setting + action + camera + light + sound
items.t: Open with one sentence on who or what and where, then add the camera, the light and the audio. Start here for Seedance 2.5 text to video prompts.

items.formula: 0–5 s: shot A. 5–10 s: shot B. …
items.t: Give each time range one action and one camera note. The 30-second and longer cards use this to keep order and pacing.

items.formula: @Image1 = who it is. Keep: face, hair, outfit. Ignore: background.
items.t: Number the files in the order you upload them and say what each one provides. Say what to drop as well, or the model may copy it.

items.formula: Move + speed + subject, e.g. slow push-in through a gap in the curtain
items.t: Name one move per shot and say whether it cuts. For Seedance 2.5 camera movement prompts, "one continuous take, never cuts" works better than a list of moves.

items.formula: Format or film stock + light + lens. Avoid: text, morphing, extra people
items.t: Real stocks, lens names and light angles set the look quickly. A short avoid line removes stray text and identity changes.
Long prompts that run in labelled ranges stay readable to you and to the model.

items.h: Describe the camera as a person.
items.t: "Filmed by a friend" or "holding the camera at arm's length" gives believable shake without technical terms.
Identity prompts restate the hair and outfit in each scene, not just the first.
Several animation cards exclude music, speech and text so only ambient sound remains.
The strongest short cards build on one event, such as a projected moon turning real.

items.question: Are these Seedance 2.5 prompts free to use?
items.answer: Yes, copy and edit them freely. The videos belong to the creators credited on each card; check the original post before reusing a clip.

items.question: What are good Seedance 2.5 prompt examples to start with?
items.answer: Begin with the featured row: it holds complete prompts that need no uploaded files. Cards marked as needing references assume the author's own images.

items.question: Which language should I write Seedance prompts in?
items.answer: Prompts here keep the author's original language. Seedance 2.5 accepts Chinese and English, plus Spanish, Indonesian, Portuguese, Japanese, Malay, Thai, Arabic, Vietnamese and Korean, up to 20,000 characters.

items.question: How long can a Seedance 2.5 video be?
items.answer: 4 to 30 seconds at 480p, 720p or 1080p. Some cards here list longer targets from their authors; split those into clips of up to 30 seconds.

items.question: How do I use reference images, videos and audio?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 takes up to 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio clips as public HTTPS URLs, and refers to them as @Image1, @Video1 and @Audio1. Reference audio can be the only reference.

items.question: What does Use do?
items.answer: It opens the Seedance 2.5 model page with the prompt filled in. Reference files are not attached, so upload your own.

items.question: How do I run a prompt through the API?
items.answer: Send it as prompt in a POST to /v1/videos, poll the task, then download the result. The API docs list every field.

items.question: Why does my clip differ from the example?
items.answer: Generation is not deterministic, and authors may have used other settings or tools. Fix a seed and change one detail at a time to compare.

items.question: Can I start from a first frame?
items.answer: Yes, with first_image_url. The video keeps that frame's aspect ratio, so leave aspect_ratio out; first and last frames cannot be combined with reference media.

guide.title: Seedance 2.5 提示词写法
guide.intro: 从下面的示例里归纳出的几种反复出现的写法，每种附可套用的模板。

items.formula: 主体 + 场景 + 动作 + 镜头 + 光线 + 声音
items.t: 先用一句话交代谁在哪里，再补镜头、光线和声音。文生视频提示词先从这里入手。
每个时间段只写一个动作和一个镜头说明。30 秒以上的卡片都靠这种写法保持顺序和节奏。

items.formula: @Image1 = 这个人。保留：脸、发型、服装。忽略：背景。
items.t: 按上传顺序给文件编号，写清每个文件提供什么，也写清要丢掉什么，否则模型可能照搬。

items.formula: 动作 + 速度 + 对象，例如“缓慢推进，穿过幕布缝隙”
items.t: 每个镜头只写一种运动，并说明是否切镜。写运镜提示词时，“一个连续镜头，全程不切”比罗列一堆运动更管用。

items.formula: 画幅或胶片 + 光线 + 镜头。避免：文字、变形、多余人物
items.t: 真实的胶片型号、镜头名和光线角度能很快定下风格；末尾一行“避免”可以去掉乱入的文字和人物变脸。
按标好的时间段写长提示词，你和模型都更容易读。

items.h: 把镜头当成一个人来写。
items.t: “朋友跟拍”“手臂伸直举着相机”这类说法，不用术语就能得到可信的抖动。
身份类提示词在每个场景里都重写发型和服装，而不是只写第一次。
好几张动画卡片排除了配乐、对白和文字，只留下环境声。

items.h: 一个片段只放一个创意。
items.t: 效果最好的短卡片都围绕单一事件，比如投影的月亮变成真的。

items.question: 这些 Seedance 2.5 提示词可以免费用吗？
items.answer: 可以，随意复制修改。成片归卡片上署名的创作者所有，复用前请先看原帖。

items.question: Seedance 2.5 提示词示例从哪几条开始看？
items.answer: 先看精选区：那里的提示词完整，不需要上传文件。标注需要参考图的卡片，默认作者自己的图片。

items.question: Seedance 提示词用什么语言写？
items.answer: 这里的提示词保留作者原文。Seedance 2.5 支持中文和英语，另有西班牙语、印尼语、葡萄牙语、日语、马来语、泰语、阿拉伯语、越南语和韩语，最多 20,000 个字符。

items.question: Seedance 2.5 能生成多长的视频？
items.answer: 4 到 30 秒，分辨率 480p、720p 或 1080p。部分卡片作者标注了更长的目标时长，请拆成不超过 30 秒的片段。

items.question: 怎么使用参考图、参考视频和参考音频？
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 最多接受 30 张图片、10 段视频和 10 段音频，都用公开 HTTPS URL 传入，在提示词里写成 @Image1、@Video1、@Audio1。参考音频可以单独使用。

items.question: “使用”按钮会做什么？
items.answer: 打开 Seedance 2.5 模型页并填好提示词。参考文件不会带过去，需要自己上传。

items.question: 怎样通过 API 运行一条提示词？
items.answer: 把它作为 prompt 发到 POST /v1/videos，轮询任务，完成后下载结果。字段说明见 API 文档。

items.question: 为什么我生成的和示例不一样？
items.answer: 生成结果不是确定性的，作者也可能用了别的设置或工具。固定 seed，每次只改一个细节再对比。

items.question: 可以从首帧开始吗？
items.answer: 可以，用 first_image_url。视频会沿用该帧的画幅比例，所以不要再传 aspect_ratio；首尾帧也不能和参考素材同时使用。

guide.title: Seedance 2.5 提示詞寫法
guide.intro: 從下方範例歸納出幾種反覆出現的寫法，每種都附可直接套用的模板。

items.formula: 主體 + 場景 + 動作 + 鏡頭 + 光線 + 聲音
items.t: 先用一句話交代誰在哪裡，再補上鏡頭、光線與聲音。文字生成影片的提示詞可以從這裡開始。
每個時間段只寫一個動作和一則鏡頭說明。30 秒以上的卡片都靠這種寫法維持順序與節奏。

items.formula: @Image1 = 這個人。保留：臉、髮型、服裝。忽略：背景。
items.t: 依上傳順序替檔案編號，寫清楚每個檔案提供什麼，也要寫出要丟掉什麼，否則模型可能照搬。

items.formula: 動作 + 速度 + 對象，例如「緩慢推進，穿過布幕縫隙」
items.t: 每個鏡頭只寫一種運動，並說明是否切鏡。寫運鏡提示詞時，「一個連續鏡頭，全程不切」比羅列一堆動作更有效。

items.formula: 畫幅或底片 + 光線 + 鏡頭。避免：文字、變形、多餘人物
items.t: 真實的底片型號、鏡頭名稱與光線角度能快速定調；結尾一行「避免」可以去掉亂入的文字與人物變臉。
依標好的時間段撰寫長提示詞，你和模型都比較容易讀懂。

items.h: 把鏡頭當成一個人來寫。
items.t: 「朋友跟拍」「手臂伸直舉著相機」這類說法，不用術語就能得到可信的晃動。
身分類提示詞在每個場景都重寫髮型與服裝，而不只寫第一次。
好幾張動畫卡片排除了配樂、對白與文字，只留下環境聲。

items.h: 一支影片只放一個點子。
items.t: 效果最好的短卡片都圍繞單一事件，例如投影的月亮變成真的。

items.question: 這些 Seedance 2.5 提示詞可以免費使用嗎？
items.answer: 可以，自由複製修改。影片歸卡片上署名的創作者所有，重複使用前請先看原貼文。

items.question: Seedance 2.5 提示詞範例該從哪幾條看起？
items.answer: 先看精選區：那裡的提示詞完整，不需要上傳檔案。標示需要參考圖的卡片，預設是作者自己的圖片。

items.question: Seedance 提示詞要用什麼語言寫？
items.answer: 這裡的提示詞保留作者原文。Seedance 2.5 支援中文與英語，另有西班牙語、印尼語、葡萄牙語、日語、馬來語、泰語、阿拉伯語、越南語與韓語，上限 20,000 個字元。

items.question: Seedance 2.5 能產生多長的影片？
items.answer: 4 到 30 秒，解析度 480p、720p 或 1080p。部分卡片作者標示了更長的目標時長，請拆成不超過 30 秒的片段。

items.question: 參考圖、參考影片與參考音訊怎麼用？
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 最多接受 30 張圖片、10 段影片與 10 段音訊，皆以公開 HTTPS URL 傳入，在提示詞中寫成 @Image1、@Video1、@Audio1。參考音訊可以單獨使用。

items.question: 「使用」按鈕會做什麼？
items.answer: 開啟 Seedance 2.5 模型頁並填好提示詞。參考檔案不會一併帶過去，需要自行上傳。

items.question: 怎麼透過 API 執行一條提示詞？
items.answer: 把它當作 prompt 送到 POST /v1/videos，輪詢任務，完成後下載結果。欄位說明請見 API 文件。

items.question: 為什麼我產生的和範例不一樣？
items.answer: 生成結果並非固定不變，作者也可能用了其他設定或工具。固定 seed，每次只改一個細節再比較。

items.question: 可以從首幀開始嗎？
items.answer: 可以，使用 first_image_url。影片會沿用該幀的畫幅比例，所以不要再傳 aspect_ratio；首尾幀也不能和參考素材同時使用。

guide.title: Seedance 2.5 프롬프트 작성법
guide.intro: 아래 예시에서 반복해 나타나는 작성 패턴과 바로 채워 쓸 수 있는 틀입니다.

items.formula: 피사체 + 장소 + 동작 + 카메라 + 조명 + 소리
items.t: 누가 어디에 있는지 한 문장으로 쓴 뒤 카메라, 조명, 소리를 더합니다. 텍스트 투 비디오 프롬프트는 여기서 시작하세요.
구간마다 동작 하나와 카메라 설명 하나만 적습니다. 30초 이상 카드는 이 방식으로 순서와 속도를 잡습니다.

items.formula: @Image1 = 이 인물. 유지: 얼굴, 헤어, 의상. 무시: 배경.
items.t: 업로드한 순서대로 번호를 붙이고 파일마다 가져올 요소를 적습니다. 버릴 요소도 적지 않으면 그대로 복제될 수 있습니다.

items.formula: 움직임 + 속도 + 대상, 예: 커튼 틈으로 천천히 밀고 들어간다
items.t: 샷마다 움직임은 하나만 쓰고 컷이 있는지 밝힙니다. 카메라 워크 프롬프트에서는 동작을 나열하기보다 '하나의 연속 샷, 컷 없음'이 더 잘 먹힙니다.

items.formula: 포맷 또는 필름 + 조명 + 렌즈. 제외: 글자, 변형, 불필요한 인물
items.t: 실제 필름 종류, 렌즈 이름, 빛의 각도로 룩이 빨리 정해집니다. 끝에 제외 항목을 한 줄 넣으면 엉뚱한 글자와 얼굴 변형이 줄어듭니다.
구간 표시가 있는 긴 프롬프트는 사람도 모델도 읽기 쉽습니다.
'친구가 따라 찍는다', '팔을 뻗어 카메라를 든다' 같은 표현만으로 자연스러운 흔들림이 나옵니다.
인물 고정 프롬프트는 첫 장면뿐 아니라 장면마다 머리와 의상을 다시 적습니다.
여러 애니메이션 카드는 음악·대사·글자를 빼고 환경음만 남깁니다.
결과가 좋은 짧은 카드는 투영된 달이 실체가 되는 것처럼 사건 하나에 집중합니다.

items.question: 이 Seedance 2.5 프롬프트는 무료로 쓸 수 있나요?
items.answer: 네, 자유롭게 복사하고 고쳐 쓰세요. 영상의 권리는 카드에 표시된 제작자에게 있으니 재사용 전에 원문을 확인하세요.

items.question: Seedance 2.5 프롬프트 예시는 어디서부터 보면 되나요?
items.answer: 추천 영역부터 보세요. 업로드할 파일 없이 쓸 수 있는 완성형 프롬프트입니다. 참조 필요 표시가 있는 카드는 작성자의 이미지를 전제로 합니다.

items.question: Seedance 프롬프트는 어떤 언어로 써야 하나요?
items.answer: 여기 프롬프트는 작성자의 원문 그대로입니다. Seedance 2.5는 중국어와 영어에 더해 스페인어, 인도네시아어, 포르투갈어, 일본어, 말레이어, 태국어, 아랍어, 베트남어, 한국어를 지원하며 최대 20,000자입니다.

items.question: Seedance 2.5 영상은 얼마나 길게 만들 수 있나요?
items.answer: 480p, 720p, 1080p로 4초에서 30초입니다. 일부 카드는 작성자가 더 긴 길이를 적었으니 30초 이하 클립으로 나눠 쓰세요.

items.question: 참조 이미지·영상·오디오는 어떻게 쓰나요?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5는 이미지 30장, 영상 10개, 오디오 10개까지 공개 HTTPS URL로 받고, 프롬프트에서 @Image1, @Video1, @Audio1로 부릅니다. 참조 오디오만 단독으로 써도 됩니다.

items.question: '사용' 버튼은 무엇을 하나요?
items.answer: 프롬프트가 채워진 Seedance 2.5 모델 페이지를 엽니다. 참조 파일은 첨부되지 않으니 직접 업로드하세요.

items.question: API로 프롬프트를 실행하려면?
items.answer: prompt에 담아 POST /v1/videos로 보내고, 작업을 폴링한 뒤 결과를 내려받습니다. 필드는 API 문서에 있습니다.

items.question: 내 결과가 예시와 다른 이유는?
items.answer: 생성은 매번 같지 않고, 작성자가 다른 설정이나 도구를 썼을 수도 있습니다. seed를 고정하고 한 번에 한 가지만 바꿔 비교하세요.

items.question: 첫 프레임에서 시작할 수 있나요?
items.answer: first_image_url로 가능합니다. 영상이 그 프레임의 화면비를 따르므로 aspect_ratio는 보내지 마세요. 첫·끝 프레임은 참조 소재와 함께 쓸 수 없습니다.

cards.preview: Montage, multi-shot candid observational footage. Do not use a single camera angle or continuous take. Handheld documentary style with the feeling of accidental real-life capture. Slightly imperfect framing, subtle handheld shake, tiny reframing adjustments, gentle exposure
cards.prompt:
Montage, multi-shot candid observational footage. Do not use a single camera angle or continuous take. Handheld documentary style with the feeling of accidental real-life capture. Slightly imperfect framing, subtle handheld shake, tiny reframing adjustments, gentle exposure breathing, and autofocus that settles half a beat late. Realistic skin texture, soft indoor natural light, film grain, shallow depth of field. Relaxed breathing, natural blinking, restrained and authentic performance. Total of 7 shots.
The woman from @ Image 1 is wearing a matching cotton pajama set consisting of a scoop-neck sleeveless top and loose shorts made from the same fabric and design. Barefoot, she lies on her stomach across a lived-in, slightly messy bed in her bedroom, browsing a mobile shopping page on a black smartphone. A house cat jumps onto the bed seeking attention, and she affectionately plays with it. Moments later, a friend calls. She answers, chats, and eventually bursts into laughter. The doorbell rings, so she ends the call and gets up to collect her dinner.
Shot 1 (0–2s):
She is already moving. One thumb scrolls through a shopping page while she frowns slightly, thinking. She quietly mutters in Korean: "아, 뭐 살랬더라…" ("Ah... what was I going to buy again?"). Lips synchronize naturally. Her bare feet gently sway behind her. A low handheld camera glides along the edge of the mattress, with soft bedding partially obscuring the foreground.
Shot 2 (2–4s):
The house cat jumps onto the bed, compressing the blanket as it walks toward her forearm and lets out a single meow. The camera gives a slight jolt from the impact, then quickly reframes from the phone to an over-the-shoulder view that includes her face, hands, phone, and cat.
Shot 3 (4–6s):
She turns warmly toward the cat, stroking it once from its forehead to its shoulders. In a gentle, affectionate tone she says: "우리 애기 왔어?" ("Did my baby come?"). Lip sync is clear and natural. The camera pushes in briefly through the cat's softly blurred foreground toward her face and hand.
Shot 4 (6–8s):
A friend's ringtone sounds. She glances down, confirms the caller, swipes to answer, and brings the phone to her ear. The camera moves in a loose semicircle from a slightly tilted overhead angle, capturing the entire answering motion.
Shot 5 (8–11s):
Her friend begins talking. She responds first with confusion, then disbelief: "어, 왜? 진짜 거짓말." ("Huh? Why? No way, you're kidding."). Immediately afterward she naturally bursts into laughter. The cat kneads the blanket beside her. A close handheld side angle keeps both her phone and profile within the same focal plane.
Shot 6 (11–13s):
A clear doorbell interrupts the laughter. Both she and the cat turn toward the bedroom door. She braces one hand on the mattress to get up. The camera reacts a fraction too late, briefly turning toward the door before naturally correcting back to her rising movement.
Shot 7 (13–15s):
Still on the phone, she hurriedly says: "어, 나 밥 왔다. 끊어." ("My food's here. I'll hang up."). She ends the call with her thumb, gets off the bed, and walks toward the door while the cat follows across the blankets. The camera slides low beneath her elbow and tilts upward as she stands in one continuous motion.
Sound:
No music. Only raw production sound: bedding rustling, quiet breathing, finger taps on the phone, the soft impact of the cat jumping onto the bed, one natural meow, faint purring, a single short incoming ringtone, call connection tone, the friend's voice through the phone, the woman's four Korean lines with accurate lip sync, a genuine brief laugh, one clear doorbell, the tap ending the call, and the soft cat footsteps. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no logo, no watermark. Never render a reference sheet or duplicate the subject.

cards.preview: CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping outside her apartment building with her dog. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally places the camera on a
cards.prompt:
CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping outside her apartment building with her dog. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally places the camera on a park bench, low stone wall, picnic table, or the ground for wider shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around sunlight, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. It should feel like authentic footage from someone's everyday life rather than a polished commercial.

STYLE: A relaxed morning lifestyle vlog. Quiet, cozy, and spontaneous. She occasionally laughs at her dog, pauses to look around, adjusts the leash, brushes hair away from her face, and speaks naturally in short sentences with comfortable pauses.

CHARACTER: EMMA — a beautiful white woman in her mid-20s. Long light brown hair in a messy ponytail, green eyes, minimal makeup, oversized gray hoodie, black biker shorts, white sneakers, and a small crossbody bag. She is walking a happy golden retriever.

SETTING: A peaceful suburban neighborhood on a sunny morning. Tree-lined sidewalks, quiet residential streets, birds singing, a small park with benches, green grass, and soft golden morning light. Very few people are around.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode. Emma holds the camera while leaving her apartment building with the golden retriever excitedly pulling on the leash.
"Good morning."
She smiles.
"Someone couldn't wait."
The dog eagerly sniffs everything as they walk down the sidewalk.
She laughs quietly.
"He has to inspect every single tree."
Still holding the camera, she walks into a small neighborhood park.
The dog suddenly stops and stares at a squirrel.
"Oh... there we go."
She smiles and gently shakes her head.
She places the camera on a nearby bench for a wider angle while throwing a tennis ball.
The dog happily chases after it.
"Worth waking up early."
She picks the camera back up.
Walking slowly through the park, she looks up at the trees for a moment.
"It's actually really peaceful out here."
The dog returns with the ball but drops it halfway.
She laughs.
"Close enough."
She sits on the bench while the dog lies beside her.
She scratches behind his ears.
"I think he's happier than I am."
She stands up and continues walking.
The camera stays in selfie mode as they head toward home.
"Coffee is definitely next."
She smiles into the lens.
"See you later."
She gives a small wave and ends the recording.

cards.prompt:
生成一段完整30秒、16:9横屏、24fps、写实电影级质感的现代近身格斗视频。使用我上传的两组人物参考图：第一名人物固定为"主角"，第二名人物固定为"敌人"。严格继承参考图中两人的面部、年龄、发型、体型、身高比例、服装、鞋子、配饰和整体气质。全程不得交换身份，不得变脸、改变服装颜色、改变体型或生成第三名参战者。

【核心风格】

参考《一个人的武林》所呈现的现代硬派武术电影气质：动作迅猛、贴身、凶狠，攻防转换极快，拳脚具有真实接触感和明确受力反馈，但不照搬电影中的人物、场景和具体镜头。以高质量ACT动作游戏的第三人称战斗镜头诠释两人对决，摄影机主要跟随主角，位于主角肩后、腰后或侧后方，使观众产生操控主角迎战强敌的沉浸感；关键格挡和重击时，可以短暂切入侧面中景或近景。

视频不要求真正一镜到底，可以在30秒内进行多次自然切镜，但整场战斗必须像一个连续长镜头般流畅。利用人物身体遮挡、立柱擦镜、快速摇镜、撞击震动和动作匹配完成隐形切镜。切镜后必须延续上一镜的动作惯性、人物位置、身体朝向、伤势和攻击方向，禁止瞬移、换位错误、人物突然恢复站姿或摄影机无理由越轴。

【场景】

深夜暴雨，一座已经停运的高架地铁检修站。站厅呈狭长矩形，地面是被雨水浸湿的深灰色防滑地砖，分布少量浅水洼，能够反射冷白顶灯和红色维修警示灯。左侧是一排金属检票闸机和关闭的卷帘门，右侧是半透明钢化玻璃护栏，护栏外能够看到高架轨道、雨幕、车灯和模糊城市建筑。站厅中段有三根粗大的混凝土立柱，柱脚带黄黑警示条，尽头是一段通往废弃站台的短楼梯。

冷白灯管是主要光源，其中两盏接触不良、偶尔闪烁；红色警示灯在墙面提供少量轮廓光。斜吹进来的雨水、潮湿薄雾、地面积水、立柱、护栏和闸机都要参与战斗。场景空间在所有镜头中保持一致，不得随切镜改变门、立柱、闸机和玻璃护栏的位置。

开场时主角位于站厅中段偏左，背后靠近检票闸机，面朝右前方；敌人位于右前方约三米处，背后是玻璃护栏。前半段战斗向站厅深处移动，中段绕过第二根立柱，后半段反向压回闸机区域。除非通过环绕镜头明确展示换位，否则敌人始终位于主角前方，保持清楚的行动轴线。

【动作原则】

动作由现代实战拳法、肘击、膝撞、低位踢击、近身控制、擒拿拆解和短距离摔法组成。主角冷静、精准、动作幅度小，善于格挡后立即反击；敌人力量更大、进攻性更强，擅长连续压迫和贴身撞击。敌人不是等待挨打的木桩，主角也不能全程无伤碾压。主角必须经历一次明显失势和一次危险化解，最后依靠判断和重心控制夺回主动。

每次进攻都必须呈现起点、运行路径、接触点和结果；格挡必须真正改变攻击方向；受击者的头部、肩膀、躯干、脚步和重心按照力量方向产生反馈。禁止隔空挥拳、拳脚穿透身体、没有接触却自行后退、无故旋转、连续空翻、悬浮和夸张飞行。动作速度快，但关键接触点必须清楚，不得用混乱残影掩盖动作。

【0—4秒：敌人抢攻】

第一帧已经处于战斗中，不进行对视、摆造型或绕圈试探。摄影机位于主角右后方约一米，接近肩部高度，采用轻微广角的第三人称ACT跟随视角。主角位于画面左侧偏中央，敌人从右前方快速逼近。前景是主角潮湿的肩膀和抬起防守的手臂，中景清楚呈现双方身体，背景是玻璃护栏、雨幕和城市灯光。

敌人右脚踩入水洼，水花向后飞散，同时右直拳攻击主角面部。主角小幅向左偏头，使拳锋擦过脸侧，左手从内侧拍开敌人手腕，右前臂立即架住敌人跟进的左摆拳。敌人不停顿，顺势用右肩和身体重量向前撞击。主角被迫后退半步，鞋底在湿地面短暂滑动，但立刻稳住。

敌人抬膝攻击主角腹部，主角双肘向内压住膝部，将冲击引向身体左侧，同时右脚切入敌人支撑腿外侧，为反击建立位置。摄影机跟随主角后退，敌人始终处于正前方。动作快速但不使用慢镜头。

【4—8秒：第一次反击】

敌人的膝部被压开，主角手臂从镜头前掠过形成遮挡，自然切换到两人右侧的平行移动机位。采用略低的中景，清楚展示脚步、髋部和拳肘路径。

主角左手控制敌人的右前臂，右拳从胸前短距离击中敌人右侧肋部。敌人的上半身因受力向左收缩，呼吸短暂中断，但立刻用左肘横击主角太阳穴。主角抬右臂挡住肘尖，前臂在碰撞中明显震动；随后转动肩膀，以左肘短击敌人胸口，再用右脚低位扫踢敌人左侧小腿。

敌人的左脚被扫得横移，但用右脚及时撑住，没有夸张腾空。他抓住主角上臂，将主角猛烈推向第一根混凝土立柱。摄影机随主角急速后退。主角后背接近立柱时用左掌撑住柱面卸力，沿柱边旋转躲避。敌人紧随而来的重拳擦过主角肩膀，砸中柱面，产生沉闷撞击、少量灰尘和疼痛反馈，但立柱不得碎裂。

敌人击中立柱时，镜头产生一次短促撞击震动。主角快速绕到立柱另一侧，摄影机紧贴主角背后绕柱跟随。立柱短暂遮满画面，完成隐形切镜。遮挡结束后，主角位于立柱右侧，敌人从左侧追出，两人沿站厅纵深向楼梯方向移动。

敌人连续使用左右直拳压迫主角。主角边后撤边格挡：右掌向外拨开第一拳，左前臂贴住第二拳。敌人第三次攻击改为右腿中段踢击。主角来不及完全避开，只能收紧左臂保护肋部。踢击真实命中护臂，力量让主角向右踉跄两步，肩膀撞上玻璃护栏。玻璃发出沉闷震颤却没有破碎，护栏外的雨夜灯光因撞击产生短暂拖影。

敌人跨步逼近，左手压住主角肩膀，右肘攻击面部。主角在最后一刻低头，肘部从头顶掠过；主角左手抓住敌人上臂，右手控制手腕，尝试将其压向玻璃护栏。敌人凭借力量强行抽臂，以额头短促撞击主角眉骨。主角头部向后偏移，额角出现轻微擦伤，目光短暂失焦。

【13—17秒：主角失势】

头撞形成明确节奏重音。快速切入主角侧面近景，表现接触瞬间、飞散雨水和真实眩晕，随即拉回能够看清全身动作的中景，不使用长时间慢动作。

敌人抓住主角上身，将他从玻璃护栏方向拽回站厅中央，右腿绊住主角左腿，试图完成向前摔投。主角身体倾斜，在倒地前用右脚重新踩稳，并以左手勾住敌人后颈，双方进入短暂贴身角力。

摄影机从主角侧后方环绕约九十度，明确展示两人换位：敌人转到画面左侧，主角转到画面右侧，主角背后变为第二根立柱和闸机方向。敌人以力量将主角压在立柱边缘，进行一次肩撞和一次短膝击。主角用大腿与前臂挡住主要冲击，但仍因疼痛弯腰。敌人抬起右肘，准备从上方向下砸击主角后背。镜头靠近主角肩后，使抬起的肘部在画面中形成强烈威胁。敌人的右肘快速下砸。主角不能凭空躲避，而是在肘击启动时向敌人身体内侧贴近，使肘尖从背后落空。主角左手托住敌人肘关节，右手控制其手腕，以肩膀作为支点向前旋转，破坏敌人的肩线。摄影机跟随主角完成半环绕，背景中的立柱、闸机和警示灯提供清楚的空间参照。

敌人为避免手臂被锁，顺势转身，以左拳反击。主角放开控制，低头闪过拳头，起身时用右肩撞击敌人胸口，将其推离立柱。主角立即以左直拳攻击敌人面部防守，迫使敌人抬高手臂；随后右拳从手臂下方击中腹部，再用左肘短击锁骨区域。三次攻击快速递进，但必须分别清楚，不能生成多条手臂。

敌人后退两步，脚后跟撞到检票闸机底座，随即用右腿横扫主角腰部。主角向前贴近，压缩踢击距离，以左臂承受大腿近端冲击，同时右手环住敌人腰侧，左脚踏到敌人支撑脚外侧。低机位镜头清楚交代主角如何控制敌人重心。

【22—26秒：环境摔投】

主角转动髋部并向斜前方发力，将失去支撑的敌人摔向闸机。敌人的肩背先撞在金属闸机侧面，闸机挡板被撞开并发出刺耳金属声，随后敌人落在湿地面，水花向外扩散。敌人的身体必须表现真实重量，不能轻飘飘飞行或在空中翻转多圈。

摄影机沿敌人落地方向快速俯冲，在触地时转为略高的斜俯视ACT视角。主角没有停下摆姿势，而是跨过被撞开的挡板继续追击。敌人翻身用右脚蹬向主角膝部，主角侧移避开。敌人借蹬腿动作翻滚起身，左手撑地，右脚踩稳，还未完全站直便挥出右摆拳。

主角从拳头内侧进入，左臂贴住敌人右臂，右掌推击敌人下颌。敌人向后仰头卸掉部分力量，同时左拳击中主角侧腹。主角明显收腹受击，却保持贴身距离，用右膝短促撞击敌人大腿前侧，进一步破坏其稳定性。两人呼吸加重，衣服逐渐湿污，但动作不能突然变得疲软。

【26—30秒：高潮反制】

摄影机回到主角左后方约一米的第三人称ACT跟随位置。主角位于画面中央偏左，敌人在正前方，背景保持被撞开的闸机、闪烁顶灯和红色警示灯。

敌人最后一次猛烈前冲，先用左拳虚晃主角面部，真正攻击是右肘横扫。主角没有被虚招骗出大幅动作，而是用右掌压下敌人左手，在右肘接近时向前踏入攻击内圈，左前臂架住敌人上臂，使肘尖从主角脑后掠过。主角抓住敌人后颈，右脚勾住其前脚踝，以肩膀向前下方施压。

敌人重心向后倒去，却抓住主角衣服试图将主角一同拖倒。主角立刻松开后颈，身体向左转出抓握，以右肘从极短距离击中敌人胸口偏肩位置，再用左掌推开敌人上胸。敌人向后撞在已经打开的闸机挡板上，挡板进一步弯曲。敌人半跪落地，一只手撑住湿地，另一只手仍保持防守，没有昏迷，也没有飞出画面。

主角受惯性影响向前半步，迅速重新稳住重心，双手保持防守，没有背对敌人、庆祝或摆胜利造型。摄影机缓慢移动到主角右侧，以主角肩膀作为前景，将焦点落在半跪喘息、暂时失去进攻能力的敌人身上。红色警示灯闪烁一次，远处传来雷声。最后一帧保持双方继续互相锁定的危险状态，让主角暂时占据优势，但为下一段战斗留下自然衔接。

【摄影、画面与声音】

保持电影级实拍质感与ACT游戏镜头的融合。主要采用肩后跟随、侧后跟随和腰部高度移动机位；关键命中使用短暂侧面中景或近景。摄影机移动快速但具有真实重量，不得漂浮、瞬移、疯狂旋转或持续无规则抖动。撞击时只使用极短、低幅度震动，震动方向与力量方向一致。

动作中允许适量运动模糊，但人物面部、手脚和接触点在关键时刻保持清晰。禁止鱼眼、长时间慢动作、子弹时间、冻结画面、速度线、游戏血条、准星、按钮提示和文字UI。ACT感来自主角中心构图、第三人称跟随、空间推进和及时的动作反馈。

超写实皮肤、肌肉牵拉、衣料褶皱、湿润头发、汗水和雨水反射；真实金属、混凝土、玻璃与湿地砖材质。冷蓝灰色为主色，冷白顶灯作为主光，红色警示灯作为局部轮廓光。高对比但保留暗部细节，高光不过曝，地面反射自然。禁止蜡像皮肤、塑料CG质感、噪点、脏污颗粒、锐化白边和压缩色块。

生成严格同步的现场声音：雨击顶棚、远处雷声、脚踩积水、湿地摩擦、衣料摆动、急促呼吸、拳掌击中皮肉、前臂格挡、肘膝碰撞、身体撞柱、玻璃震颤和闸机金属回响。无需对白。音乐仅保留极其克制的低频脉冲，不能盖过格斗音效。

【负面约束】

禁止身份互换、面孔漂移、服装变化、身体比例突变、多余人物、复制人物、多手多脚、关节反折、身体穿透和人物粘连；禁止隔空受击、动作没有惯性、敌人静止等待、无故滑行、瞬移、悬浮、武侠轻功、气功、能量特效、夸张冲击波和墙体爆炸；禁止主角全程无伤碾压，禁止敌人只会挨打；禁止无意义空镜、英雄登场、长时间对视、重复招式和结尾突然黑屏。

最终效果必须呈现清晰的动作结构：敌人强势抢攻、主角短暂反击、绕柱追击、主角失势、危险拆解、重新夺回主动、利用闸机完成摔投和最终反制。30秒全程高强度、无废秒，刺激而不混乱，凶狠但遵守人体力学，摄影机始终以主角为核心。

cards.preview: Original scene, 30 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. 0–8 seconds: Inside a packed underground London techno club. The camera holds tightly on the face of a young English woman. She is Caucasian, brunette, with delicate features and melancholy behind her eyes. She remains
cards.prompt:
Original scene, 30 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts.

0–8 seconds: Inside a packed underground London techno club. The camera holds tightly on the face of a young English woman. She is Caucasian, brunette, with delicate features and melancholy behind her eyes. She remains centered in frame and only sways subtly with the music. Around her, the crowd moves intensely and chaotically, with bodies, arms, shoulders and faces constantly passing close to camera, creating strong motion blur and a sense of pressure and overwhelm.

Fast white strobe lights flash continuously, pushing the image back and forth between near-total darkness and sudden bursts of harsh illumination. In the darker intervals, only silhouettes, rim light, glints of sweat and fragmented movement are visible. Each flash briefly reveals fragments of her face—her eyes, cheekbones, wet strands of hair, and distant expression—before she disappears again into darkness. She feels strangely still and emotionally detached while the crowd around her becomes a mass of blurred bodies and flickering light. Heavy four-on-the-floor techno dominates the soundscape, loud, compressed and physically overwhelming.

8–16 seconds: She stays in this space for a moment longer, absorbing the intensity, then finally breaks her gaze, turns and begins pulling herself out of the crowd. The camera does not cut. It releases from the locked close-up and shifts into a close handheld follow shot, staying just behind and slightly beside her as she pushes through dancers. Bodies knock into her shoulders. Arms and backs occasionally obscure the frame. The camera feels intimate, bumped and instinctive, struggling through the same crowded space with her.

As she leaves the center of the dancefloor, the strobing becomes less dominant and the club lighting grows dirtier and more practical. She enters a narrow back passage leading away from the main room.

16–23 seconds: She moves through a cramped, dirty corridor with graffiti-covered walls, peeling paint, torn posters, exposed pipes, damp patches, flickering fluorescent lights and littered plastic cups on the floor. People lean against the walls smoking, chatting, waiting, watching others pass. She threads through them silently. The camera stays close and observational, catching the rustle of fabric, brief shoulder contact and bodies slipping past in the narrow space.

The music becomes more muffled and distant as she moves farther from the dancefloor. The heavy techno remains present only as a low, dulled throb through the walls. Footsteps, clothing friction, breathing, shuffling bodies and indistinct overlapping crowd chatter become clearer. No individual conversation is intelligible. She does not speak.

23–30 seconds: She pushes through the exit and steps into the cold London night. Outside the club, groups of people stand smoking, talking, drifting in and out of the entrance. Streetlight mixes with spill from the doorway and practical urban light. She walks to the nearest dirty exterior wall and pauses. With slightly shaky hands, she lights a cigarette. The flame briefly illuminates her face. She takes a drag, leans back against the wall, then slowly slides down into a seated position on the pavement.

The camera follows her downward and settles at her level, then holds. She sits smoking in silence, looking past the moving crowd into the distance, disconnected from everything around her. People continue crossing the frame, talking, laughing and smoking nearby, but she feels completely alone inside the busy environment.

The sound transitions from overwhelming club techno, to muffled bass and corridor ambience, to distant low-frequency vibration outside mixed with cigarette lighter clicks, breathing, street ambience, footsteps and indistinct smoker chatter. No dialogue.

The overall image should feel raw, naturalistic and grounded, with visible film grain, slight exposure fluctuation, realistic skin texture and subtle handheld instability. Avoid glossy polish, commercial beauty lighting and music-video slickness.

cards.preview: Core Style: Fast, vivid, unstable. Fully hand-drawn with rich organic textures. Every transition is fluid and natural—never rigid or mechanically cut. The entire frame, including the background, remains in constant motion, driven simultaneously by emotion, gravity, and heat.
cards.prompt:
Core Style: Fast, vivid, unstable. Fully hand-drawn with rich organic textures. Every transition is fluid and natural—never rigid or mechanically cut. The entire frame, including the background, remains in constant motion, driven simultaneously by emotion, gravity, and heat. Every frame should feel alive, unpredictable, and physically reactive.

[0–7.5s: Origin and Chain Reaction]

[0–1.5s]

A central abstract figure erupts into violent motion. Its emotional color core radiates outward as irregular pulsating waves while its silhouette tears apart in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like compressed soft paper. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl rapidly across the entire frame, moving significantly faster than the figure itself, creating intense tension between body, skin, and surface.

[1.5–3s]

The separated contours accelerate into nervous linear forms. The figure's colorful core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains. Some ribbons snap backward while others whip violently forward, leaving trembling trails behind. Empty spaces between movements ignite into new forms that emerge to fill emotional voids.

[3–4.5s]

Every shape surges diagonally across the composition. One massive form folds like fabric, revealing layered textures of grain, chalk, wet ink, scratched paint, and rough pigment beneath its surface. The background folds together with it, twisting into entirely new color fields. Smaller forms are dragged into constantly evolving speed lines.

[4.5–6s]

The image fractures into four emotional forces: calm, violence, vulnerability, and ecstasy. Each absorbs color from the others. Shadows appear before their objects, behaving like prophecies. The original forms chase these shadows, but the shadows mutate faster—becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant until they surpass the objects themselves.

[6–7.5s]

A rapid chain reaction begins. Colliding forms generate visual motifs derived from the reference imagery: fragments, symbols, silhouettes, stains, and expressive linework. These newly born motifs accelerate in different directions. Frozen traces solidify into new entities before melting again and splitting into tiny emotional echoes.

---

[7.5–15s: Compression and Extreme Transformation]

[7.5–9s]

The entire frame collapses toward an invisible point beneath the center. Every visual layer compresses inward at a different speed. Maximum compression lasts for only one frame before exploding upward and outward with vertical smears, shaking outlines, and exaggerated overshoot motion. Every element vibrates before settling into a completely new position.

[9–10.5s]

Textures migrate between forms. Dry rough textures sharpen previously fluid shapes into angular structures. Liquid textures soften rigid forms until they sag and drip. Luminous colorful textures dissolve into the background, causing the environment itself to pulse rhythmically. Every object changes behavior according to the texture it inherits.

[10.5–12s]

A massive rotational force sweeps across the frame. Every form flips, inverts, or turns inside out, exposing hidden reverse sides possessing qualities of hands, hooks, flames, or waves. Every collision triggers escalating chain reactions, transforming the entire visual world into an entirely new emotional reality.

[12–13.5s]

All boundaries dissolve. Forms merge, repel, and merge again, generating hybrid entities that inherit the colors and movement of their predecessors while becoming completely different beings. The background pushes forward into the foreground, becoming part of the forms themselves while releasing new shapes from within.

[13.5–15s]

Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum intensity: contour separation, color bleeding, texture migration, and shadow-leading motion. Every frame is densely packed with intentional visual impact, fully absorbing and reinterpreting every reference element introduced earlier.

---

[15–22.5s: Fragmentation and Neurotic Storm]

[15–16.5s]

The storm collides with an invisible barrier. The center explodes into countless shards of water-covered broken glass. Within each fragment, glowing spiral irises rotate violently, generating centrifugal force that stretches and tears at the shard edges. Neon magenta and electric blue leak through every crack.

[16.5–18s]

The fragments fuse into overlapping collaged human faces. The faces are composed of purple stains, scratched paint, and rough pigment. Their expressions oscillate continuously between terror and ecstasy. Jagged lightning-like lines pierce through them like exposed nerve fibers, violently stitching the faces together.

[18–19.5s]

Color saturation reaches its peak. Electric blue lines solidify into physical cables stretching throughout space, twitching uncontrollably while releasing neon magenta sparks. The compressed paper background burns away, transforming into a charred, granular carbon-black surface.

[19.5–21s]

Gravity reverses. Liquid elements such as water droplets and wet ink surge upward while broken glass continues falling downward, producing intense visual tearing. Vertical smears appear along the edges of the frame as though an unseen force is physically wiping the entire animation off the canvas.

[21–22.5s]

Every form is pulled into countless miniature spiral-iris black holes. The irises rapidly expand until they dominate the entire screen, spinning at an increasingly suffocating speed. The rough tactile quality of chalk and dry brush textures contrasts violently against the brilliant electrical center, creating overwhelming sensory overload.

---

[22.5–30s: Aftershock and Eternal Echo]

[22.5–24s]

The giant iris evolves into pulsating biological tissue. The image breathes with a neurotic rhythm. Hidden symbols and textures appear and disappear beneath muscular contractions. Paint seepage creates convincing depth, as though layered across multiple transparent sheets of film.

[24–25.5s]

The animation enters an intense high-frequency vibration. Every object freezes in place while its edges oscillate violently like strings stretched to their breaking point. Violet shadows crawl across every surface, attempting to consume the remaining light.

[25.5–27s]

Rainbow-colored glass fragments and water droplets sweep across the frame like rain, refracting and distorting everything behind them through lens-like optical effects. Colors become heavy fluid masses that sink downward, leaving behind anxious, restless linear marks.

[27–28.5s]

The entire composition collapses into a single glowing horizontal jagged line. The background becomes a dark neon field filled with coarse grain. The line contains all accumulated energy, twisting violently while alternating flashes of electric blue and neon magenta pulse across it.

[28.5–30s]

The glowing line disintegrates into hand-drawn dust particles that drift rhythmically across the screen before gradually reassembling into one enormous blurred luminous silhouette. The final frame ends with tiny blocks of color continuing to vibrate subtly, leaving behind an everlasting emotional aftershock.

cards.prompt:
日本のフルカラーアニメ映画、シネマティック高品質映像。
BGMなし、セリフなし、字幕なし、文字なし、環境音あり。
フルサイズ換算24mm F1.4の広角レンズで撮ったような浅い被写界深度とボケ感。
手前の前ボケは大きく柔らかく、背景は自然に溶ける。

# 制約
すべてのカットで画角・アングル・焦点距離を変えて単調にしない。
各カットの角括弧内の数値は、そのカットの開始時刻と終了時刻を秒で示す。
この時刻配分に従って全カットを描き、最後のカットまで到達すること。
姿勢の定義：彼女は全カットを通してキッチンに立って調理している。
屈む動作、座る動作、部屋を出る動作は映さない。
配置の定義：シンクは画面左、コンロは画面右。作業は画面左から右へ移っていく。
カメラは常にカウンターの手前側にあり、この左右関係を全カットで維持すること。
光の定義：唯一の光源は暖かいアンバーの室内灯。
光の状態は全カット通して一定に保ち、時間帯は変えない。
奥行きの定義：すべてのカットで前景・中景・遠景を明確に分離する。
前景には湯気・水の筋・カウンターの縁などを大きくボカして配置し、
被写体を手前から覗き込むような奥行きを作る。
パララックスの定義：カメラが移動するカットでは、
前景を最も速く、中景を中程度、遠景を最も遅く動かし、三層の速度差を明確につけること。

# 登場人物
## 女性
成人女性。
ショートパンツ、裸足、黒いネイル。
人に見せることを意識していない、深夜の部屋着姿。

# 情景
深夜のモダンなキッチン。大きな窓越しに夜景が広がる。
暖かいアンバーの室内灯だけが空間を照らし、
光と影が肌の輪郭をやわらかく浮き上がらせる。
調理の湯気と熱気が空気をわずかに揺らしている。
誰にも見られていない、静かで親密な深夜。
小物の定義：アサリは大量にあり、ステンレスの大きなボウルの中で
底一面に幾重にも重なって水に沈んでいる。
オリーブオイルは細長い透明なガラス瓶に入っており、
口には細い金属の注ぎ口が差してある。傾けて注ぐ。
白ワインは濃い緑のガラス瓶で、ラベルには文字が入っていない。
刻んだパセリはカウンターの小皿に用意されている。
皿は白い浅いパスタ皿が1枚だけ。
奥行き構成：前景に湯気とカウンターの縁、中景に彼女と調理器具、遠景に窓の夜景。

# シーン
深夜、女性が一人でボンゴレを作る。
貝を洗うところから盛り付けまで、料理の手順と彼女の仕草を交互に見せる。
湯気・貝の艶・素肌・何気ない動作が自然にシーンに溶け込んでいく。

cut1: [0.0-1.9]
ワイドショット、斜め後方から。カメラが画面左へゆっくり横移動する。
画面左のシンクの前に立つ彼女の後ろ姿。流水が細く落ちている。
手前を湯気の立つ大鍋の輪郭が大きくボケて速く横切り、
中景の彼女はゆっくりと相対的に流れ、
遠景の窓の夜景はほとんど動かない。三層の速度差を明確につける。
室内灯が背中を暖かく縁取っている。
環境音：流水の音、遠い街のざわめき。

cut2: [1.9-3.2]
クローズアップ、正面のやや上から見下ろす。
流水の下、ネイルを施した両手が山盛りのアサリを掻き混ぜている。
指の間で無数の黒い殻がこすれ合い、表面から細かい砂が流れ落ちていく。
シンクの中にはまだ大量のアサリが積み重なったままになっている。
指先が冷水でわずかに赤らんでいる。
環境音：貝殻がこすれ合う連続した音、水がステンレスを叩く音。

cut3: [3.2-5.4]
クローズアップ、正面のローアングル。
あおりの構図で、前屈みになった上体を下から見上げる。
手前で流水の筋が大きくボケて画面の右端を縦に横切っている。
紺色のくせ毛が重力で前に垂れている。
目線は手元の水に落ち、表情はクールで集中している。
前屈みの姿勢で襟元の布が体から離れて前に垂れ、
鎖骨から胸元へ続くラインが自然に見える。
跳ねた冷水の粒が首から鎖骨に散り、
一粒が鎖骨のくぼみをゆっくりと滑り落ちていく。
水面の反射光が下から顎と首をゆらゆらと照らす。
環境音：流水の音。

cut4: [5.4-6.4]
マクロ、斜め上から。
木のまな板。ネイルを施した指がにんにくを押さえ、
包丁が薄い断面を次々と落としていく。
にんにくの汁が刃に薄く光る。
手前にまな板の木目の縁が大きくボケて入る。
環境音：包丁がまな板を叩くリズミカルな音。

cut5: [6.4-7.6]
クローズアップ、湯面すれすれの水平から。
大きな鍋が激しく沸騰している。
パスタが束になって湯の中へ落ち、白い泡と湯気が勢いよく立ち上がる。
手前を立ちのぼる湯気が厚くボケて流れる。
環境音：激しい沸騰音、パスタが湯に入る音。

cut6: [7.6-8.6]
マクロ、フライパンの縁スレスレの真横から。
まだ冷たいオリーブオイルの中に、にんにくの薄切りと赤唐辛子が沈んでいる。
オイルがゆっくりと温まり、にんにくの縁から細かい泡が立ちはじめる。
環境音：オイルが温まりはじめる微かな音。

cut7: [8.6-9.8]
クローズアップ、右斜め上から。
熱したフライパンの上でボウルが大きく傾けられ、
大量のアサリが一斉に滑り落ちていく。
無数の黒い殻が次々と熱した金属に当たって跳ね、フライパンを埋め尽くす。
油が細かく飛び散る。
手前を薄い湯気がボケて流れる。
環境音：貝が金属に当たる連続した硬い音、油が跳ねる音。

cut8: [9.8-11.2]
クローズアップ、真上からの俯瞰。
緑のガラス瓶の口だけがフレームに入り、ゆっくりと傾けられる。
透明な白ワインが細い一筋の弧を描いて熱したフライパンへ落ちていく。
液体が熱面に触れた瞬間、白い湯気が勢いよく立ち上がり、フレームの上へ抜けていく。
画面に入るのは瓶の口と液体の筋だけで、貝は湯気の下に隠れている。
環境音：液体が熱面で沸き立つ音、湯気が噴き上がる音。

cut9: [11.2-12.3]
クローズアップ、正面の目線の高さ。
ガラス蓋がフライパンにかぶせられる。
蓋の内側が白く曇っていき、その向こうで貝の輪郭がぼやけて見えなくなる。
環境音：ガラスが金属の縁に置かれる音、蓋の中でこもった沸騰音。

cut10: [12.3-15.0]
超クローズアップ、斜め後方のやや低い位置から。
浅い被写界深度で、うなじだけに焦点が合い、
手前の湯気と奥のキッチンは完全に溶ける。
蓋の中の沸騰を待つ間、彼女がわずかに顔を伏せる。
髪が前へ流れて左右に分かれ、うなじが下から順に露わになっていく。
短い産毛が湯気の水分を吸って濡れ、細い束になって肌に張り付いている。
首の付け根から肩へ続くくぼみに影が落ち、その縁を室内灯の光が細く縁取る。
呼吸に合わせて肩がゆっくりと上下し、うなじの肌がわずかに伸び縮みする。
横顔の輪郭と耳の下端だけがフレームの端にわずかに入る。
カメラ固定。
環境音：蓋の中でこもった沸騰音、静かな呼吸。

cut11: [15.0-16.3]
ミディアムクローズアップ、斜め前方のやや低い位置から。
ガラス蓋が持ち上がり、抑えられていた白い蒸気が一斉に噴き上がる。
蒸気が画面の手前を厚く覆い、フライパンの中身が一瞬見えなくなる。
環境音：蓋が外れる音、蒸気が解放される音。

cut12: [16.3-18.6]
クローズアップ、顔アップ、正面やや斜め上から。
立ちのぼった蒸気が彼女の顔をゆっくりと包む。
目がゆっくりと閉じられ、顔がわずかに後ろへ引かれる。
前髪と首筋の産毛が湯気の水分を吸って濡れ、肌に張り付いている。
頬に薄く水滴が浮き、光を受けて細かく光る。
湯気が顎の線に沿って流れ、一筋の雫が首筋をゆっくりと下りていく。
唇がわずかに開き、細い吐息がこぼれる。
カメラ固定。
環境音：蒸気の音、微かな吐息。

cut13: [18.6-19.9]
クローズアップ、左斜め上からの浅い俯瞰。
蒸気が薄れた先で、フライパンを埋め尽くしたアサリが一斉に口を開いている。
無数の殻の内側から乳白色の身が現れ、
白濁した汁が貝の間で細かく泡立って揺れている。
環境音：汁が煮立つ音、殻が開く硬い音。

cut14: [19.9-22.1]
超クローズアップ、真横から。
木の小さなスプーンがすでに唇に触れている。
白濁した汁がゆっくりと口の中へ流れ込み、唇が閉じる。
喉がわずかに動いて汁を飲み下す。
目が細くなり、視線がどこかへ漂う。
スプーンがゆっくりと離れ、下唇に薄く汁の艶が残る。
舌先が下唇をゆっくりとなぞる。
カメラ固定。
環境音：遠くの沸騰音だけが続く静かな間。

cut15: [22.1-23.5]
クローズアップ、背後の高角度から肩越し。
彼女の肩から後頭部がフレーム上部に入り、その先にフライパンが見下ろせる構図。
肩の布と肩甲骨が手前に大きくボケて見える。
トングが湯を纏った麺を持ち上げ、口を開いた貝と白濁した汁の中へ静かに下ろす。
麺が汁を吸い込み、フライパンの中が満たされていく。
環境音：麺が汁に落ちる音、汁が煮立つ音。

cut16: [23.5-25.4]
ミディアムクローズアップ、真後ろのやや高角度から。
フライパンの柄を握った腕が手前に引かれ、フライパンが煽られる。
腰から肩へ力が伝わり、肩甲骨と背中の筋肉が波打つように連動する。
湯気を吸って湿った薄い生地が背中の動きに素直に沿い、
肩のあたりで肌に張り付いたまま揺れる。
肩にかかった布の縁が動きのたびにわずかに位置を変える。
奥で麺と貝がフライパンの中を舞い上がり、
落ちてくるたびに汁が白くとろみを増していく。
環境音：フライパンが振られる金属音、汁が跳ねる音。

cut17: [25.4-27.4]
クローズアップ、右斜め前方から。
熱気の中、汗の細い雫が首筋をゆっくりと伝い、
鎖骨のくぼみに小さく溜まってから、そこを越えて胸元へ滑り落ちていく。
手首の甲がゆっくりと額をなぞる。
目がゆっくりと細くなり、細い吐息が唇からこぼれる。
カメラ固定。
環境音：微かな吐息、遠くで汁が跳ねる音。

cut18: [27.4-28.5]
クローズアップ、皿の高さの水平やや斜めから。
トングが麺を白い浅い皿の上に巻き上げ、
その周りに口を開いたアサリが放射状に置かれていく。
麺の艶と貝の内側の光沢が浮かび上がる。
環境音：盛り付けの音。

cut19: [28.5-29.3]
クローズアップ、皿のすぐ上、斜め上からの浅い俯瞰。
フレーム上部から指先だけが入り、刻んだ緑のパセリを摘まんで開く。
細かい葉が指の間からこぼれ、ゆっくりと舞いながら皿の上へ降りていく。
白濁したソースと貝の上に緑が点々と散っていく。
指先がゆっくりとフレームから消える。
環境音：パセリが落ちる微かな音、湯気の音。

cut20: [29.3-30.0]
クローズアップ、浅い被写界深度、真横から。
完成したボンゴレの皿。フレーム上部から、
細長い透明なガラス瓶を握った黒いネイルの手が入る。
瓶の口には細い金属の注ぎ口が差してある。
瓶がゆっくりと傾けられ、注ぎ口から緑がかった黄金色のオイルが
細い一筋になって落ち、皿の上を横切るように回しかけられる。
瓶が起こされてオイルの筋が途切れると、
手と瓶がゆっくりとフレームから消え、皿だけが暖かい光の中に残る。
湯気が細く立ちのぼり続ける。
カメラ固定。静かに余韻が漂う。
環境音：オイルが落ちる微かな音がやみ、夜の静寂へ。

cards.preview: **CAMERA:** DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect
cards.prompt:
**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts per location (dim early-morning dorm → fluorescent vocal room → mirror-lit practice room → stark evaluation room lighting).

**STYLE:**
Nostalgic, determined montage feel — younger, rawer energy than her current polished vlogs, evoking a flashback to trainee days. Quick cuts stitched across locations, reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood shifts from tired to focused to nervous, ending on quiet resolve.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean trainee (ref image), late teens/early 20s (younger, flashback version of herself). Long straight black hair, often in a simple ponytail or braid, minimal to no makeup, tired but determined eyes. Wearing simple practice clothes — a plain long-sleeve top and joggers or sweats, fully covering arms and torso, no jewelry.

**Setting Progression**

Trainee dorm room (early morning) → vocal lesson room (morning) → dance practice room (afternoon) → evaluation room (evening).

**Storyboard (15s, 5 cuts)**

1. *(~3s, dorm, propped camera, dim early light)* She wakes up before sunrise, rubbing her eyes, quietly getting ready in the dark so as not to wake roommates. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Back then, mornings started before the sun even came up."

2. *(~3s, vocal room, handheld, fluorescent light)* She stands at a mic, sheet in hand, focused and a little nervous, mouthing through warmups. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every note mattered — you never knew who was listening."

3. *(~3s, practice room, handheld, mirror wall)* She's mid-motion rehearsing choreography, sweat forming, repeating a step over and over. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "I must have run that same eight-count a hundred times."

4. *(~3s, practice room, macro insert)* Close-up on her feet repeating the same step, breathing audible, tape blur softening the motion. No narration — ambient practice room sound only.

5. *(~3s, evaluation room, wide-to-close, tense finish)* She stands nervously in front of unseen evaluators, hands clasped, taking a steadying breath before the camera holds on her face. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "That was the version of me that started all of this."

cards.preview: Create a 30 second 16:9 cinematic social video set inside a modern chiropractic and mobility clinic during late morning. The room has pale warm walls, clean wood flooring, black padded treatment tables, gray visitor chairs, a few green plants, subtle wall art, and tall windows
cards.prompt:
Create a 30 second 16:9 cinematic social video set inside a modern chiropractic and mobility clinic during late morning. The room has pale warm walls, clean wood flooring, black padded treatment tables, gray visitor chairs, a few green plants, subtle wall art, and tall windows overlooking leafy trees. Use natural daylight mixed with soft ceiling light, realistic skin texture, true fabric behavior, accurate anatomy, physically believable contact, consistent faces, and natural micro expressions. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no surreal motion.

From 0 to 4 seconds, open on a wide establishing shot with a slow handheld push through the clinic. A calm male practitioner in a charcoal shirt guides an adult male client in a white shirt toward a treatment table. Other staff move softly in the distant background. The mood feels professional, relaxed, and observational.

From 4 to 8 seconds, cut to a medium seated shot. The client sits centered while the practitioner stands behind him, gently checking shoulder level and neck rotation. Use small natural camera drift, shallow depth of field, window light on one side of the face, and realistic eye contact. Show quiet anticipation without exaggerated acting.

From 8 to 12 seconds, move into a close side angle as the practitioner carefully positions the head for a controlled neck release. Keep the motion restrained and anatomically correct. Capture a quick release, a subtle facial reaction, a sharp breath, and an immediate smile. Let the camera react with a tiny authentic handheld movement rather than a dramatic shake.

From 12 to 17 seconds, cut to a medium wide side view of the client lying on his side on the table. The practitioner braces the shoulder and pelvis, pauses, then performs one compact lumbar adjustment. Show realistic weight transfer, table cushion compression, shirt folds, breathing, hand pressure, and a brief surprised laugh from the client.

From 17 to 22 seconds, cut to the client lying face down. The practitioner palpates the upper back, stacks both hands, and applies one controlled thoracic compression. Use a slightly lower camera angle, soft reflections on the table, gentle background activity, and a brief focus pull from the hands to the client’s relieved expression.

From 22 to 26 seconds, transition to a head of table view. The client lies on his back while the practitioner places a black traction strap beneath the base of the skull. Build tension slowly and safely, then deliver one short controlled pull. The client reacts with wide eyes, then laughs and covers his face for a moment.

From 26 to 30 seconds, finish with the client sitting upright, rolling his shoulders and turning his neck comfortably while the practitioner stands beside him. End on an honest shared smile and a slow pullback that reveals the bright clinic. Keep the final moment calm and satisfying, not promotional.

Audio should feel captured on location with soft room ambience, distant clinic movement, clothing rustle, table creaks, natural breathing, quiet conversation without clearly audible words, and crisp but not exaggerated adjustment sounds. Add a low volume modern instrumental track with warm piano, soft bass, light percussion, and a gentle rise at each release, ending on a clean resolved note.

cards.preview: 1980s film, authentic live-action footage shot on 35mm with heavy grain, vibrant yet gritty saturated colors, practical neon lighting mixed with harsh strobes and fog. Fast chaotic editing packed with abrupt cuts, glass reflections, POV inserts, strobe flashes and dynamic
cards.prompt:
1980s film, authentic live-action footage shot on 35mm with heavy grain, vibrant yet gritty saturated colors, practical neon lighting mixed with harsh strobes and fog. Fast chaotic editing packed with abrupt cuts, glass reflections, POV inserts, strobe flashes and dynamic movement to create total disorientation and panic. Real practical squib blood, rubber tentacles and physical stunts. Period-accurate 80s performances: big hair, colorful outfits, leg warmers, exaggerated fear and desperate physicality. Visualized synth atmosphere through pulsing lights and sudden dead silence.
[IMAGE REFERENCES] Generate from scratch a consistent group of five mid-80s young adults with distinctly different looks—tall blonde mullet guy in neon shirt, short chubby dark-curly guy in Hawaiian print, slim big-curled redhead girl in neon dress, athletic black-ponytailed girl in crop top, lanky glasses brunette in pastel polo—in colorful yacht-party fashion and one original giant octopus killer with thick rubber tentacles and gaping beak. All on a neon-drenched luxury yacht in pure practical 1980s slasher style.
[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND] 0-3s: [Rapid Disorientation Montage] Quick jarring cuts on the dimly lit yacht deck at night. Neon lights pulsing, five friends laughing and dancing with drinks, music blasting. Inserts: champagne spilling, one girl’s smile fading as mist rises from the water, glass reflection briefly showing a massive tentacle that vanishes. Strobe flicker. Laughter dies as engines are dead and no land in sight.
3-6s: [Rising Panic Montage] Fast cuts as panic spreads. Tall blonde runs to the helm, radio smashed. Close-up of broken mic. Two girls huddle near railing, eyes wide, calling names that echo. Low-angle POV gliding through thick fog. Drink glass tips. They split—one to cabins, one to stern. Water reflections show tentacles moving unseen.
6-9s: [First Attack Sequence] Sudden violence, rapid-fire cuts. Giant octopus erupts from foggy water. Quick cuts: massive tentacle lit by strobe, slamming down, bright squib blood spray across pink jacket. Body drops hard on wet deck. Others scream and scatter, slipping. One girl falls. Octopus advances with heavy tentacle movements while neon keeps pulsing.
9-12s: [Full Chaos & Practical Kills] Frenzied montage. Multiple cuts: guy racing for life raft, tentacle appears behind him. Girl hides behind bar, tentacle smashes through, practical blood on counter. Another cornered against cabin wall, lifted and slammed, body slides leaving red streak. Feet scraping, bodies falling, fog swirling around practical gore. Violent strobes. Survivor swings boat hook, dull thud on tentacle.
12-15s: [Climax & Lingering Threat] Fast cuts. Last two desperately lower a life raft. One yanked into fog and water, scream cut short. Final girl turns, face sweat-and-blood covered, backing on slippery deck. Wide shot of yacht littered with bodies under pulsing neon. Octopus rises again, tentacle cracked but massive. She runs into darkness as strobe freezes on the gaping beak. Slight film burn at end.
[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS] Photorealistic 1980s film emulation, heavy natural grain and reel artifacts, authentic practical squib blood and rubber-tentacle stunts, coherent physics with realistic slips and momentum on wet wooden deck.

cards.prompt:
【风格】武侠电影级动作喜剧（Wuxia Action Comedy），古风客栈实景，8K，达芬奇高级调色，升格慢动作与快剪结合，真实布料与木屑物理，横屏16:9
【时长】30秒
【场景】古风江湖客栈大堂，木桌长凳、红灯笼、蒸笼冒热气，梁柱交错，光从窗棂斜射带浮尘
【角色】女侠A @图1（红衣冷艳，用剑）、女侠B @图2（青衣飒爽，用双筷/软鞭），两人武艺相当

[00:00-00:02] 钩子·同时出手
蒸笼掀开——热气散去，只剩孤零零一个白胖包子。两只手"唰"地同时探向它，在包子上方一寸僵住。镜头拉近两人对视，杀气骤起。
音效：蒸汽"嘶"声，一声兵刃出鞘。

[00:02-00:06] 拔剑·桌面开打
A拔剑挑翻整张桌子腾空，B踩着飞起的长凳跃上房梁，包子被气浪震到空中。碗筷茶壶四散飞溅。

[00:06-00:11] 空中争夺（升格）
包子在半空划弧，两人凌空交手，A剑尖挑、B筷子夹，包子在刀光间被抢来抢去，谁也没碰实，热气还在包子上冒。

[00:11-00:16] 客栈大乱
战场蔓延，两人踩桌翻梁、灯笼被削落、木屑纷飞，其他"食客"抱头躲桌下。包子始终在两人争夺中心悬着不落。

[00:16-00:21] 决胜一击（升格特写）
A与B同时使出绝招，剑气与鞭影在包子两侧交汇——包子被劲气托着高高弹起，两人各自摆出接杀造型，屏息等它落下。

[00:21-00:26] 神反转
镜头跟着下落的包子——一只慵懒的橘猫"喵"地从桌上跃起，在半空一口叼住包子，稳稳落地，当着两人的面吧唧吧唧吃完，舔爪。
音效：所有打斗音效戛然而止，一声"喵~"，乌鸦飞过。

[00:26-00:30] 傻眼收尾（定格）
A和B保持着帅气的接杀姿势僵在原地，剑和筷子还举着，齐刷刷看向吃饱打嗝的猫，表情裂开。
字幕（砸出）：「有些仗，打赢了也没用。」
音效：一记喜剧"咚"，猫满足地打了个嗝。

【导演备注】1.反差铁律：打斗越是天崩地裂、招式越华丽正经，最后被猫截胡的落差越好笑；2.身份锁定：A=@图1红衣用剑、B=@图2青衣用筷/鞭，脸/服装全程一致；3.节奏：2秒对峙→拔剑→空中争夺→大乱→决胜→猫反转，动作段用快剪+关键处升格；4.物理真实：包子热气、木屑、灯笼、布料惯性、猫的重量都要真实，武侠不卡通；5.包子必须全程在画面中心被争夺，是视觉焦点和笑点核心；6.不见血、不伤人，纯招式对拆。
【负面提示词】卡通武侠，塑料CG，换脸，两人身份/武器混淆，包子中途消失，猫出现得太早，血腥伤人，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面糊乱，未成年人形象。

cards.preview: 16:9, 30 seconds, an epic photorealistic fantasy cinematic long take, original worldbuilding, one continuous shot, continuous camera movement, no hard cuts, and no references to any existing film, character, actor, or recognizable cinematic scene. OVERALL STYLE: A high-budget
cards.prompt:
16:9, 30 seconds, an epic photorealistic fantasy cinematic long take, original worldbuilding, one continuous shot, continuous camera movement, no hard cuts, and no references to any existing film, character, actor, or recognizable cinematic scene.

OVERALL STYLE:
A high-budget fantasy film aesthetic with realistic cinematography, monumental world scale, and a beautiful protagonist with natural skin, realistic expressions, and believable body proportions. The overall tone is intelligent, elegant, mysterious, and courageous, never childish, cartoonish, or exaggerated cosplay. Four locations are connected through one continuous flight path: Iceland’s black coastline, an alternate Victorian London, a Paris-inspired city at night in the rain, and a futuristic New York-inspired aerial metropolis.

UNIFIED COLOR PALETTE:
Deep black, silver-gray, and warm gold remain the dominant colors throughout the film. Iceland adds cold blue; London adds gray-green and amber; Paris adds deep blue and wet gold; New York adds deep teal, silver-white, and gold. Maintain realistic atmospheric perspective, thin mist, rainfall, wet surfaces, glass reflections, and volumetric light throughout. Avoid a video-game look, concept-art appearance, and plastic materials.

MAIN CHARACTER:
There is only one female protagonist throughout the entire video. She is approximately 28 years old, slender, exceptionally beautiful, intelligent, elegant, and quietly determined. Her refined facial features are completely original and must not copy any real actor or movie character. She has naturally bright eyes, clearly defined eyebrows, a soft but strong facial structure, natural skin tone, realistic skin texture, and a restrained, focused expression.

She has warm chestnut-brown hair reaching her waist, naturally wavy at the ends. Part of her hair is blown behind her shoulders by the wind. Her hairstyle must remain identical throughout the entire film.

She wears a deep forest-green long coat, an ivory high-neck blouse, a dark-red knitted scarf, brown leather wrist guards, dark-gray trousers, and worn leather boots. Her costume has an elevated British fantasy aesthetic, but she does not wear a school uniform or pointed hat. Do not include badges, school emblems, magical-school symbols, recognizable character costumes, or elements from any existing film.

She rides the same original flying broom throughout the sequence: a dark, aged wooden handle with silver-gray metallic fibers at the rear and a small warm-gold light at the front. The broom’s shape, size, color, and materials must never change.

HER OBJECTIVE:
She is flying through different cities to carry the small warm-gold light toward the far edge of the clouds. She is not a combat character. She does not attack anyone or cast explosive magic. She simply continues forward through cities, coastlines, fog, rain, and high-altitude air. Her emotional progression moves from concentration to wonder, then finally to freedom and determination.

0-5 SECONDS: TAKEOFF FROM ICELAND’S BLACK-SAND BEACH
The shot begins extremely low above a black volcanic beach using a 24mm wide-angle lens. Black ocean waves are on the left, towering basalt columns on the right, and blue-white glacial mountains in the distance. Cold blue clouds press down across the sky, while a narrow line of warm golden sunset remains near the horizon.

The beautiful female traveler rapidly enters from the rear right of the frame, riding her broom just above the ocean surface. Her chestnut-brown hair streams backward in the sea wind. Her dark-red scarf creates a clean motion line behind her, while her deep forest-green coat moves naturally in the airflow. The warm-gold light at the front of the broom illuminates the sea mist and droplets of water.

The camera follows her from behind with a stable FPV movement, keeping her slightly right of center. It must not circle around to the front or allow her to leave the frame. Her body leans slightly forward; one hand holds the broom handle while the other maintains balance. She flies toward a massive wall of blue ice.

At the fourth second, she enters a natural裂缝 beneath the ice wall. The ice passes rapidly along both sides of the camera. Cold blue crystals briefly intersect with the warm-gold light, creating the first natural transition. No explosion, magical smoke, or sudden transformation.

5-12 SECONDS: VICTORIAN LONDON IN THE FOG
As the ice clears the lens, the environment naturally becomes an alternate Victorian city at night. The protagonist and broom retain exactly the same direction, speed, clothing, appearance, and flying posture. The camera continues following from behind.

Below are wet dark-gray stone streets. Red-brick buildings, black iron bridges, narrow windows, and old amber streetlamps line both sides. Several dark-red double-decker public vehicles without text or branding move slowly through the fog. The city should evoke Victorian London without reproducing real landmarks.

The camera gradually transitions from fast FPV pursuit into a smooth three-quarter rear tracking shot, moving approximately 45 degrees to her left side. Her beautiful profile appears briefly. Her eyes remain focused, and her hair and scarf maintain stable continuity. The warm-gold light leaves only a short trail through the rain and fog.

She passes beneath a black elevated iron bridge. Its steel structure moves across the top of the frame as a brief physical occlusion. The camera does not cut, and when the obstruction clears, she remains on the same movement axis.

At the tenth second, she flies into a massive arched railway station. Its roof is made from black steel beams and wet glass, with rainwater flowing across the surface. The roof completely covers the frame, creating the second natural transition.

12-19 SECONDS: PARIS-INSPIRED CITY IN THE RAIN
When the glass roof clears the camera, the environment becomes a romantic, original Paris-inspired city at night in the rain. Do not reproduce real landmarks. Preserve only the atmosphere of stone bridges, a river, narrow streets, classical stone buildings, wrought-iron balconies, and warm window light.

The protagonist flies low above a broad river. The water reflects golden windows and the deep-blue night sky. Pale-gray stone buildings, tall narrow windows, wet rooftops, and fine rain lines extend along both sides. Her deep-green coat and dark-red scarf form a clear silhouette against the blue city, while her chestnut hair streams backward.

The camera moves into a parallel tracking position on her right side. The broom stays approximately three meters above the river. The camera remains slightly below shoulder level, preserving the spatial relationship between the woman, broom, river, and architecture. She passes beneath a sequence of classical stone bridges whose arches form continuous reflections in the water.

At the seventeenth second, she enters a long mirror corridor made from wet glass walls. The reflections may show only the same woman, the same broom, and the same warm-gold light. Do not create duplicate people. Rainwater, city lights, and reflections slide along the glass surfaces.

A powerful warm-gold light appears at the end of the corridor. She flies toward it, creating the third natural transition.

19-24 SECONDS: FUTURISTIC NEW YORK-INSPIRED CITY
The mirror corridor opens into an original futuristic New York-inspired metropolis. The camera rapidly but smoothly shifts from the three-quarter rear position into a controlled forward-facing FPV shot moving backward in front of her. Her beautiful, focused face, chestnut hair, dark-red scarf, and the golden broom light are briefly visible.

Below are wet streets, glass skyscrapers, metallic elevated bridges, and enormous urban canyons. The buildings reflect golden light, a deep-teal night sky, and silver-white mist. All screens and glass surfaces must remain abstract and free of text, advertisements, logos, or branding.

She flies between two skyscrapers. The glass wall on the left passes close to the camera, while a vast urban canyon opens on the right. The camera briefly maintains its backward-facing position before completing one stable 90-degree upward movement, transitioning from her face to a position above her.

Do not spin rapidly, make her tumble, or transform the broom into an aircraft. She remains graceful, skilled, and stable.

At the twenty-third second, she bursts out from between the skyscrapers. The city lights rapidly become smaller below her, while the warm-gold light at the front of the broom becomes the only stable light source near the center of the image.

24-30 SECONDS: THE FINAL WORLD ABOVE THE CLOUDS
The camera continues rising at high speed and passes through a dense layer of cloud. When the clouds clear, the protagonist appears high above a vast cloud sea, hovering on her broom.

She gradually slows down and changes from a forward-leaning posture to a more upright position. Her chestnut hair and dark-red scarf move backward in the high-altitude wind. The camera moves from the front to her right rear side, then rises into a high-angle 24mm wide shot.

Distant traces of the four worlds appear below without forming a chaotic collage: Iceland’s black coastline and blue glacier on the far left; London-inspired red-brick structures and gray-green fog in the middle distance; Paris-inspired golden waterways and stone bridges on the right; and silver-white lights from the New York-inspired glass city at the lowest level.

These locations must exist only as distant spatial layers. Do not suddenly reproduce four complete cities or make buildings float and reorganize. A warm golden horizon appears at the edge of the clouds, suggesting that another world is waiting beyond it.

At the twenty-eighth second, the protagonist raises her right hand. The warm-gold light at the front of the broom emits one thin beam toward the horizon. The beam only illuminates a new path through the clouds. It does not explode, create a giant energy sphere, or alter her appearance.

During seconds twenty-nine to thirty, the camera becomes completely stable. The protagonist, broom, cloud sea, distant layers of the four cities, and golden horizon are all clearly visible. She appears as a beautiful but small figure near the lower center of the frame, facing the open world. The final emotion is freedom, wonder, and the sense that the journey will continue.

CAMERA AND PACING:
0-5 seconds: low-altitude rear FPV pursuit.
5-12 seconds: smooth three-quarter rear tracking through London.
12-19 seconds: parallel low-altitude tracking through Paris.
19-24 seconds: one controlled front-facing backward FPV movement through New York.
24-30 seconds: continuous rise into a high-angle wide establishing shot.
Use FPV speed only during the Iceland takeoff and New York skyscraper passage. Keep the London and Paris sections controlled, elegant, and spatially readable.

SOUND DESIGN:
Iceland: ocean waves, cold wind, low glacial rumbling, and subtle vibration from the wooden broom.
London: rain, steam, iron-bridge resonance, and distant wheels.
Paris: rain droplets, water, distant bells, and low strings.
New York: low urban rumble, wind pressure across glass, and metallic structural resonance.
Above the clouds, all city sounds gradually fade, leaving high-altitude wind, a subtle metallic resonance from the broom fibers, and one warm sustained string note.

CONTINUITY RESTRICTIONS:
Only one female protagonist appears throughout the video.
She must remain exceptionally beautiful, natural, and realistic, with stable original facial features that do not copy any actor or film character.
Her chestnut-brown hair must retain the same color, length, and hairstyle.
Her forest-green coat, ivory blouse, dark-red scarf, brown wrist guards, dark-gray trousers, and worn boots must remain unchanged.
The broom must remain the same dark aged wooden broom with silver-gray metallic fibers and a warm-gold front light.
Do not add companions or other flying characters.
Do not include pointed hats, school uniforms, magical schools, badges, school emblems, castles, recognizable film characters, superhero logos, or brand symbols.
Do not generate text, subtitles, advertisements, UI elements, logos, or readable signs.
Do not allow buildings to melt, drift, resize, or suddenly reorganize.
Do not create duplicate figures in mirrors.
Maintain realistic physical behavior for ice, rain, water, glass, fog, and clouds.
Do not use hard cuts, sudden spinning, random shaking, abrupt zooms, body deformation, face replacement, explosions, large-scale destruction, or unmotivated effects.
Keep the protagonist, broom, flying direction, city geography, and lighting transitions continuous and visually traceable.

cards.preview: Create a 30 second photorealistic fashion transformation video in a 16:9 landscape frame. A stylish young woman with long softly waved brown hair, warm medium skin, round black glasses, small earrings, natural makeup, and consistent facial features stands in the same modern
cards.prompt:
Create a 30 second photorealistic fashion transformation video in a 16:9 landscape frame. A stylish young woman with long softly waved brown hair, warm medium skin, round black glasses, small earrings, natural makeup, and consistent facial features stands in the same modern office washroom or dressing area for the entire video. The background has large charcoal gray stone tiles, a pale ceiling, a slim black wall rail on the left, and a narrow metal partition line on the right. Keep every architectural line perfectly fixed across all cuts.

Camera is locked on a tripod at eye level, medium full shot from mid thigh upward, using a natural 35 mm equivalent smartphone lens. The subject remains centered with enough space on both sides for the landscape composition. No camera shake, zoom, reframing, or perspective change. Use crisp realistic detail, true skin texture, fine hair strands, believable fabric folds, accurate hands, subtle breathing, and tiny posture adjustments. Lighting is soft cool overhead office lighting with gentle facial fill, mild reflections on the gray tiles, consistent exposure, and realistic shadow direction.

Begin with her palm very close to the lens, briefly obscuring most of the frame. She pulls her hand away and reveals the first outfit, a sleeveless pale blue floral office dress with a light scarf over one shoulder. She looks calmly into the camera, lowers her arm, places one hand on her hip, glances upward with a mildly unimpressed expression, then folds her arms. Match this exact folded arm pose for the first invisible jump cut.

Across the next twenty four seconds, reveal nine distinct office outfits through clean pose matched cuts timed to the music. Use a lemon yellow floral kimono blouse, a relaxed ivory button shirt with navy trousers, a fitted black sleeveless top with dark tailored pants and a brown belt, a soft blush pink top with black trousers, a deep green crew neck blouse, a vivid blue paisley shift dress, a black and white dotted peplum blouse, a camel blazer over a cream top, and a final elegant burgundy wrap dress. Between changes, give her natural confident gestures such as a small shoulder bounce, two thumbs up, hands settling on hips, crossing her arms, turning her chin, smoothing a cuff, lightly flicking her hair, pointing toward her cheek, and smiling directly at camera. Each gesture should begin in one outfit and end in the next so the cut feels practical and intentional, never like body morphing.

Hold each look long enough to read clearly, roughly two seconds per outfit, with cuts landing on strong beats. Preserve identical body position, hair direction, glasses placement, limb anatomy, background geometry, and lighting at every transition. Avoid warped fingers, changing facial identity, floating clothing, cloth melting, duplicated accessories, sudden camera motion, or artificial beauty smoothing.

For the final four seconds, she lands in the burgundy dress with one hand on her hip, gives a warm playful smile, taps one finger lightly against her cheek, then reaches toward the lens until her palm fills the frame, creating a natural practical ending. Do not add captions, logos, watermarks, interface graphics, or generated text.

Music should be an upbeat polished fashion pop instrumental at about 112 beats per minute with tight percussion, light bass, finger snaps, bright synth accents, and clean beat drops for every outfit change. Add subtle realistic clothing movement, bracelet clicks, and a soft hand whoosh at the opening and closing. The finished result should feel like a real creator filmed several office looks in one location and edited them precisely to music.

cards.preview: Duration: 20s | 16:9 | 24fps Duel from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, battle at Hulao Pass, late Han dynasty. REFERENCES Image 1 — 呂布 LU BU Image 2 — 関羽 GUAN YU Image 3 — 張飛 ZHANG FEI Use them for IDENTITY ONLY: face, beard, hair, headwear, armour, cloak colour, build
cards.prompt:
Duration: 20s | 16:9 | 24fps Duel from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, battle at Hulao Pass, late Han dynasty. REFERENCES 
Image 1
 — 呂布 LU BU 
Image 2
 — 関羽 GUAN YU 
Image 3
 — 張飛 ZHANG FEI Use them for IDENTITY ONLY: face, beard, hair, headwear, armour, cloak colour, build, proportions. IGNORE their white studio background, flat studio lighting and standing pose — none of it appears here. Every shot is outdoors, and all three men are mounted and fighting. STYLE (all beats) A dusty plain before a huge stone mountain pass at dusk. Two vast armies on either side, banners rippling, dust in the air. Overcast sky, low copper sun breaking through. Palette: iron grey, ochre dust, blood red, bronze. Desaturated and earthy. 50mm, shallow focus, heavy haze, film grain, high contrast, hard rim light through the dust. Photorealistic historical epic, sweat and grime, worn scratched armour. No fantasy glow, no magic. WEAPONS — no reference exists. Build from this, keep identical throughout. Each is 1.5x its owner's height. Never swap them. 呂布: ji halberd — straight spear point, one crescent side blade below it on one side, long dark shaft, bronze fittings. 関羽: guandao — one heavy broad curved blade with a hook on its back edge, joined to a long dark shaft by a bronze dragon head. 張飛: serpent spear — slender steel blade forged in an S-shaped wave, on a plain dark shaft bound with cord. HORSES — no reference exists. Anatomically correct, four legs, correct joints. 呂布: large red-chestnut stallion, black mane, bronze fittings, red tassels. 関羽: tall dark bay, black mane and lower legs, plain leather tack. 張飛: heavy solid black, thick neck, shaggy fetlocks, battered iron tack. BEAT 1 (0-4s) 呂布 — clean-shaven, gold headdress with two pheasant feathers, red cloak, halberd, red-chestnut horse — sits alone between the two armies, halberd across his saddle. The horse stamps and turns a half step. He raises the halberd and levels it at the enemy line. Camera: WS from low, slow push-in. BEAT 2 (4-8s) 張飛 — bristling beard, black iron armour, dark cloak, serpent spear, black horse — bursts from the line at a gallop, roaring, and drives the spear at 呂布. 呂布 turns the halberd across his body and knocks it aside. Sparks and dust. The horses wheel past each other. Camera: tracking alongside at horse height, moving with the charge. BEAT 3 (8-12s) 関羽 — long smooth black beard, ruddy face, dark green robe over armour, green headwrap, guandao, dark bay horse — rides in from the far side, rises in the stirrups and cuts down overhead. 呂布 catches it on the haft. Both strain, blades locked, horses shoulder to shoulder. Camera: MCU, orbiting once around the locked weapons. BEAT 4 (12-16s) All three circle in churning dust, weapons striking and turning each other aside, horses rearing. 呂布 in red and gold, 関羽 in green, 張飛 in black iron. Cut tight to 呂布's eyes under the headdress — narrowing, calculating, uncertain for the first time. Camera: handheld, close, drifting between them. BEAT 5 (16-20s) 呂布 wrenches his horse around, sweeps the halberd once to drive them back, and gallops for the pass, red cloak and feathers streaming. 関羽 and 張飛 pull up side by side, chests heaving, weapons still raised, watching him go against the low copper sun. Camera: WS, pulling out to reveal both armies. AUDIO War drums and massed shouting throughout, rising through beats 2-4. Hooves on dry earth, snorting horses, steel ringing on steel, creaking leather, wind and dust. A deep roar from 張飛 at 4s. Near-silence for a breath at 12s on 呂布's eyes, then the clash returns. No dialogue. AVOID white studio background, flat studio lighting, seamless backdrop, neutral standing poses, facial hair on 呂布, on-screen text, subtitles, watermarks, modern objects, fantasy glow, magic, wire-work floating, clean unworn costumes, faces/armour/weapons swapping between beats, weapons changing shape or length, horses with deformed or extra legs, extra or missing limbs, more than three warriors, mixed camera moves, jitter, flicker, ghosting.

モード：R2V。参照画像に写っているキャラクターを主人公として使用する。参照画像から、キャラクター本人の顔立ち、頭部の形状、髪型、髪色、瞳の形と色、肌や外皮の色、体格、頭身、首・腕・脚の長さ、衣装の形状・色・素材感、装飾品、履物、固有の身体的特徴、全体のシルエットと雰囲気だけを参照する。人間、動物、亜人、妖怪、ロボット、怪物など、参照画像のキャラクター種族と身体構造をそのまま維持する。参照画像に存在しない髪、角、耳、尾、翼、装飾品、衣服、武器、身体部位を勝手に追加しない。参照画像が三面図、設定資料、キャラクターシート、複数アングル画像の場合は、すべて同一キャラクターの外見確認用資料として扱う。三面図、文字、寸法線、枠線、カラーチャート、注釈、設定資料のレイアウト、余白、背景は映像に出さない。参照画像に武器が描かれている場合でも、元々身体の一部として固定されているものを除き、この映像内では後述する二本の赤い刀剣を使用する。尺30秒、16:9、24fps、全12カット。画面分割なし。1990年代OVA調のセル画。太い茶褐色の主線、フラットな一段影、くすんだ黄土色・灰褐色・暗い藍・褪せた赤・砂色を中心とした低彩度の配色。キャラクター本来の識別色は維持しつつ、全体を退色したセル画の色調へ調整する。ガッシュの筆跡が残る手描き背景、16mmフィルム粒子、軽い色収差、明部のハレーション。基本は二コマ打ち。決めの動作と強い衝撃の瞬間だけ一コマ打ち。AI補間された均一で滑らかな動きにせず、セル画らしい明確なポーズの切り替え、タメ、詰め、残像、作画の緩急を使う。主人公の顔、頭身、身体各部の長さ、衣装の形状はカットごとにわずかに作画変化してよい。ただし、参照画像から抽出した最も特徴的な頭部形状、目、髪または頭部装飾、身体構造、衣装、装飾品、履物、全身シルエット、色の配置は全カットで維持する。別人化、別衣装化、年齢変化、性別変化、種族変化を起こさない。主人公の視線方向、二本の刀剣の本数、刀剣を持つ手、斬撃の軌道、敵との位置関係をカット間で連続させる。四足歩行や多腕など人型ではないキャラクターの場合は、その身体構造に適した姿勢と動作へ自然に置き換えるが、物語上の行動とカメラ演出は維持する。手や腕を持たないキャラクターの場合は、前脚、触手、翼、口、身体周辺の浮遊操作など、そのキャラクターに自然な方法で二本の刀剣を扱わせる。カメラは各カットで役割を変え、無意味な手ブレ、常時揺れるカメラ、目的のない旋回を使わない。①0〜2.5秒：空からの落下。広大な砂漠を見上げる地面すれすれの超ローアングル。青白い空の中央から主人公が落下してくる。カメラは主人公の落下に合わせて短く後退し、参照画像のキャラクターにおける特徴的な衣装、身体、脚部、履物、尾、翼など、画面下側へ向くシルエットを広角パースで巨大に見せる。主人公は姿勢を完全には制御できず、身体構造に沿って回転しながら落ちる。顔や特徴的な頭部が一瞬見え、参照画像の本人性が明確に分かる。②2.5〜5秒：どさっと倒れる。カメラを砂面の高さまで下げ、主人公の落下地点を正面から待つ。主人公が砂地へどさっと叩きつけられ、砂煙が円形に広がる。衝撃の瞬間だけ一コマ打ち。カメラは衝撃に合わせてわずかに後退し、砂煙の中から倒れた主人公の特徴的な全身シルエット、身体部位、衣装や装飾品の一部を見せる。身体構造に反する折れ方や関節、余分な手足を作らない。③5〜7.5秒：瞬きと覚醒。倒れた主人公の顔または頭部のタイトクローズアップ。目が存在するキャラクターの場合は、カメラをほぼ固定し、砂の粒だけが顔や頭部の周囲を落ちる。瞳が閉じたまま一度だけ小さく震え、ゆっくり瞬きして開く。目が開く瞬間、カメラがわずかにドリーインする。主人公の視線が地面から正面へ移る。複眼、一つ目、多眼、発光部、ディスプレイなど通常の瞳を持たない場合は、参照画像に存在する視覚器官や顔の発光部が一度弱く揺れた後に覚醒する演出へ置き換える。瞳や発光色は参照画像の色を維持する。④7.5〜10秒：無数の黒い敵。主人公の目元または顔のクローズアップからカメラが素早く引き、背後の広大な砂漠を見せる。地平線まで無数の黒い人型の敵が立っている。カメラは主人公を前景に残したまま、低い位置からゆっくり半周し、敵群が全方位から主人公を囲んでいることを見せる。黒い敵は完全な黒に近い単純な人型シルエットで統一し、安定した頭身と形状を維持する。顔、衣装、武器、赤い発光部などを追加せず、腕を伸ばしてゆっくり近づくだけ。主人公と同じ外見にしない。⑤10〜12.5秒：線画の刀剣生成。主人公が刀剣を扱う身体部位の極端なクローズアップ。人型の場合は両手、四足の場合は前脚付近、手を持たない場合は口元、触手、翼端、身体周辺など、キャラクターの身体構造に適した位置を映す。カメラは砂の上または身体周辺の生成地点へゆっくり寄る。赤い一本の線画が一筆ずつ明確に描かれ、空中へ立ち上がり、反りのある片刃の刀の輪郭を形成する。同じ工程でもう一本が形成され、輪郭の内側が赤い光で満たされて二本の刀剣になる。二本は同じ長さと形状を持ち、赤い光が刃の峰を走る。線画は途中を省略せず、一筆ずつ段階的に形成され、完成後は補助線だけが消えて刀剣本体が残る。刀剣の本数を一本や三本以上に変えない。⑥12.5〜15秒：最初の斬撃。地面すれすれのローアングルで主人公を見上げる。主人公が二本の刀剣を身体構造に合った方法で左右へ構え、カメラは前方へ短くドリーインする。主人公が砂を蹴って一歩または一跳びで踏み込み、手前の黒い敵を斜めに斬る。刀剣が敵に触れる瞬間だけカメラを接触点へ寄せる。黒い敵は血や肉を出さず、厚みのない黒い平面の破片へ砕ける。主人公の腕、脚、触手、翼などを増殖させず、刀剣の左右と斬撃方向を維持する。⑦15〜17.5秒：黒敵群の連続撃破。カメラは主人公と横並走し、手前を黒い敵の大きくぼけたシルエットが次々に横切る。主人公は低い姿勢で左右の刀剣を交互に振り、敵を一体ずつ斬る。人型以外の場合も参照画像の移動方法と身体構造に従い、地面を走る、跳ぶ、滑る、飛ぶなど自然な方法で前進する。カメラは横移動から短い前方追従へ変わり、斬撃のたびに主人公の特徴的な頭部、顔、腕、脚、首、尾、翼、衣装などが広角パースで大きく強調される。身体を不自然に溶かしたり、別形状へ変形させたりしない。黒い敵は黒い平面破片となり、砂煙とともに散る。⑧17.5〜20秒：青い巨大恐竜の出現。黒い敵群が倒れた直後、カメラは主人公の背後からゆっくり引き、砂漠の一時的な静けさを見せる。背後の地平線が暗くなり、巨大な青い影が立ち上がる。カメラは主人公の肩越し、頭越し、背中越しなど、その身体構造に適した位置から上へティルトし、空を覆うほど巨大な恐竜型の敵を見せる。恐竜は主人公とは異なる外見を持ち、青い外皮、濃紺の影、巨大な顎、鈍い黄色の目、重い脚を持つ。恐竜は一歩踏み出すだけで砂丘を揺らす。主人公の全身が恐竜の足先よりもはるかに小さく見える明確なスケール差を作り、恐竜を小型化しない。⑨20〜22.5秒：青い恐竜に食べられる。カメラは恐竜の足元から頭部へ見上げる強い煽り。恐竜が巨大な口を開き、主人公を正面から飲み込もうと前進する。カメラは主人公の正面へ後退しながら追従する。主人公は二本の刀剣を構えて抵抗しようとするが間に合わず、砂ごと巨大な口の暗闇へ吸い込まれる。主人公の身体や衣装を恐竜の歯で切断しない。恐竜の顎が閉じる瞬間、画面が完全な黒へ落ちる。血、負傷、肉片、咀嚼、体液を描かない。⑩22.5〜25秒：暗闇の中の瞳。完全な暗闇。環境音が消え、主人公の呼吸音または小さな作動音だけが聞こえる。画面中央に主人公の瞳、複眼、発光部、ディスプレイなど、参照画像に存在する視覚的特徴が浮かび上がる。色、形、個数、配置を参照画像どおりに維持する。カメラはその光へ非常にゆっくりドリーインする。主人公の特徴的な頭部形状、顔の輪郭、髪、角、耳、首などが暗闇の中から少しずつ見える。身体は見せすぎず、瞳または発光部と頭部の輪郭だけで主人公の存在を示す。参照画像の瞳や発光部を黄色へ変更しない。⑪25〜28秒：恐竜の内部から赤い刀光。主人公が二本の刀剣を構える。赤い線画の光が二本の刀身から伸び、暗闇の中で恐竜の内部を大きな弧として描く。カメラは主人公の周囲を小さく回り込み、赤い刀光が身体の周囲を一周する様子を見せる。主人公の身体的特徴、衣装、装飾品の輪郭が赤い光で一瞬だけ照らされる。次の一コマで、複数の赤い斬撃線が恐竜の青い外皮へ内部から到達し、外側へ向かって赤い裂け目が走る。恐竜の内部を肉体的、解剖学的、写実的に描写しない。背景は抽象的な暗闇のみとし、赤い線、主人公の輪郭、青い外皮の亀裂だけで表現する。⑫28〜30秒：内部からの脱出。恐竜の青い外皮が、内部から走った赤い刀光によって大きく左右へ割れる。血、肉、骨、内臓を描かず、青い外皮を厚みの少ない巨大なセル画状の破片として表現する。カメラは恐竜の外側へ急速に後退し、赤い光の裂け目から主人公が飛び出す姿を正面のローアングルで捉える。主人公は二本の刀剣を左右へ振り抜き、青い破片と赤い光が砂漠へ散る。主人公は身体構造に適した姿勢で砂地へ着地する。着地後、参照画像で最も特徴的な瞳、顔の発光部、頭部、表情のいずれかが画面中央で強調される。主人公の本人性が分かる最終ポーズを約0.5秒維持する。最後は強いハレーションで白く焼け、音と映像を同時にハードカットする。音響：BGMなし。風、砂、落下音、衝撃音、衣 cards.prompt: A 30 second film from ONE completely locked, static camera position that never moves, never pans, never zooms, never cuts. The same view of the same patch of ground for one thousand years, time passing at enormous speed. In the foreground of every single frame sits a large mossy grey boulder. It never moves. It is present and recognisable in every frame of the film from first to last. [0:00-0:03] Ancient temperate forest. Huge old trees, deep green undergrowth, mist between the trunks, soft grey daylight. [0:03-0:06] Trees fall and are dragged away. A clearing opens. Stumps, churned mud, a first thin column of smoke. [0:06-0:09] A single timber and thatch hut rises beside the boulder. A small vegetable plot. Chickens. [0:09-0:12] A village grows around it. More huts, fences, a dirt track, wood smoke, sheep in the field beyond. [0:12-0:15] A stone wall is built, incorporating the boulder into its base. A church tower rises behind. Snow falls and melts. Seasons flicker past. [0:15-0:18] Fire. The village burns, timbers collapse, smoke blackens the sky. The wall and the boulder survive. [0:18-0:21] Rebuilding in brick. A cobbled road. A chimney, then many chimneys. Industrial smoke, grey air, rain. [0:21-0:24] The town becomes a city. Concrete rises. The old wall is demolished. The boulder sits in a small paved square, surrounded by buildings. [0:24-0:26] Glass towers. Traffic light streaking past at night. The boulder is fenced off, a small green plaque beside it. [0:26-0:28] Abandonment. Windows dark, glass cracked, weeds through the paving, ivy climbing the towers. Silence. [0:28-0:30] The towers have collapsed and gone. Young forest has grown over everything. Mist between the trunks. The frame is now identical to the opening frame, the same boulder in the same position under the same soft grey light. Camera: absolutely locked and static for all 30 seconds. No movement of any kind. No cuts, no dissolves, no transitions — one continuous transforming shot. Style: photoreal, cinematic, natural overcast light throughout, muted natural colour, seasons and weather flickering rapidly past. Audio: diegetic only, evolving with the era — forest birds, axes, village life, church bell, fire, industrial machinery, city traffic, then silence, then birds again. NO MUSIC, no score, no soundtrack, no instruments. No text, no captions, no titles, no watermarks, no camera movement, no cuts. created with @higgsfield

cards.prompt:
A contestant balances across a spinning foam roller over a pool, wobbles, and wipes out into the water - a full Japanese game-show obstacle bit, crowd cheering in the stands. Comedy timing and a physical pratfall are genuinely tough for AI and this holds.

Most people test a new model on hero shots - dramatic, slow controlled. A game-show wipeout is the opposite: fast physical comedy, a body losing balance, a crowd reacting water splashing on impact. That's a much harder thing to make land.

Here's why a clip like this is a real test

1. Physical comedy depends on timing the failure. A pratfall only works if the wobble, the overbalance, and the fall happen in the right rhythm. Too smooth and it's not funny; too random and it's not believable
2. A reacting crowd has to sell it. Rows of spectators clapping and watching in the stands do the same job the crowd does in any live-event clip -the audience reaction is what makes it feel real
3. Water and impact are a physics stress test. Body hitting a surface, then a splash, is exactly the kind of contact-plus-fluid moment that used to fall apart instantly
4. It's a specific, recognizable format. Japanese game-show obstacle courses have a distinct look and energy -nailing the genre, not just a generic person falling, is the flex

Why this matters

• Comedy and physical failure are underrated benchmarks - everyone tests drama, far fewer test a convincing wipeout 
• The version leap is the real story: putting the Seedance 2.0 generation side by side is how you actually judge progress, not marketing claims 
• Physical comedy landing at all is a sign the model is handling timing and balance, not just pretty stills
Worth being straight about
• A side-by-side against the 2.0 version is the honest way to show a jump - a single clip alone proves less than the comparison does 
• A teaser clip is the best-case cut - the real test is running your own awkward, physical, timing-dependent scene through it

Everyone benchmarks new models on the dramatic hero shot. The quieter test is whether it can make you laugh at someone falling off a foam roller -and that's a harder problem than it looks.
